concept: EBS: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1/io2) for transactional DBs
tests: Choosing an EBS volume type for a high-load transactional DB with consistently high IOPS.
expected: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1/io2) — guaranteed high IOPS and low latency. Triggers: "high-transaction database", "consistent high IOPS", "low-latency block storage".
why_not: gp2 — baseline IOPS depends on size and doesn't guarantee the required performance; st1 — throughput HDD; sc1 — cold storage.
